refusal.buffer: int32 source slots, zero before launch; any nonzero slot refuses the entire gradient
refusal.attribution: Device slots identify the source; the host constructs the 32-byte AdFailureRecord.

topology_transpose.cell_offsets/cell_edges/cell_slots: transpose n_adv, adv_cells, sorted by (edge, slot); validate ranges, cardinality, and each forward incidence; geometry fixed

invariants: all device buffers and cotangents disjoint unless an alias is explicitly declared
validate dimensions, topology ranges and reverse incidence before launch
forward native rounded helper expressions determine selected branches
derivative outputs with refusal records are discarded
precision_policy: Inputs, outputs and stored cotangents are f32. Contributions to an input read more than once are accumulated in fixed order in f64 and rounded once to f32 at the final store (COMMON-AD section 40). The captured forward is unchanged.
branch_records: TL recomputes each active predicate and increments uint32[slot][arm]; fixed integer and config branches have no record.
generation_reason: Hand row in the assigned group; no generated rows were assigned to this reconcile.
